name: carelia-backend
description: API REST et Socket.io de Carelia

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node --import ./scripts/test-guard.mjs --test-concurrency=1 --test dist/integration.test.js dist/edge.integration.test.js dist/messaging.integration.test.js dist/unit.test.js dist/server.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && node --import ./scripts/test-guard.mjs --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=99 --test-coverage-branches=96 --test-coverage-functions=100 --test-concurrency=1 --test dist/integration.test.js dist/edge.integration.test.js dist/messaging.integration.test.js dist/unit.test.js dist/server.test.js
